observed_behavior: SC 2.4.4 Level A requires link purpose determinable from link text alone or link text together with programmatically determined link context, with stated ambiguity exception.
context: Normative WCAG 2.2 Recommendation, 12 Dec 2024; criterion level/exception preserved
limitations: Does not require every link text independently identify destination without context; 2.4.9 is a separate AAA SC.
notes: SC text authority only; no site accessibility testing
